about: Custom types P2: a class names a custom type in its keys. WOLFMOM (harness_type_class) has preg_mon_type_override "wolf" and birth_class {goblin 1, ..., wolf 2}: any father gives a wolf pregnancy, a wolf birth gives monster class 0 (the second WOLFMOM entry overrides the first, whose wolf entry is 2) and lists WOLFMOM in the wolf's birth list, and both survive a save/reload. The load remap also renumbers an underground birth's payload (a made-up save: wolf saved as 5 is now 4).
